02
fractionation

Analyze and collect time-resolved fractions

HP 1090 with diode-array UV–vis detection; sequential ZORBAX 60-S and 300-S columns. Equivalent chromatographic dimensions can include permanent aggregates and are not crystalline-core sizes. Base is proposed to prevent adsorption by ionizing surface OH groups; electrolyte screening helps pore access. The analytical elution times are not synthesis residence times.
